verdict.rationale: The evidence shows NVIDIA ships a full CUDA Toolkit with a compiler, runtime, libraries, and Nsight profiling tools, and the RTX 5080 page pitches the card for AI development with GPU-optimized SDKs and PyTorch backends. Support for this card as a CUDA target is therefore strongly implied. However, no cited documentation explicitly lists the RTX 5080 (or Blackwell consumer parts) as a supported CUDA target. Missing for 10: an explicit CUDA supported-GPU or compute-capability listing for RTX 5080, toolkit version requirements, and independent or hands-on confirmation of shipping CUDA workloads on this card.
